spans.s:
खोल् खोल्, cl. 1. P. खोलति, to limp, to
be lame.

खोल, अस्, आ, अम्, limping, lame; (अम्), n. a
helmet; [cf. Gr. χωλός.]
—खोल-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्,
furnished with a helmet or armour for the head.

खोलक, अस्, m. a helmet, armour for the head; an
ant-hill; a pot, a saucepan; the shell of a betel-nut.
